welcome.title: How do you start learning to drive?
welcome.p1: Deciding to learn driving is a big step. When you begin with the right understanding and a clear plan, it does not have to feel difficult.
welcome.p2: The first thing to do is research nearby driving schools. Check whether the institution is approved, whether it has experienced instructors, and review the fee and course structure before fixing a school. Choosing a good school makes the learning experience much easier.
welcome.p3: To get a licence, you must pass two tests. The first is the learner's licence test, a theory test that checks whether you know road rules and signals. After that comes the driving test, a practical test to confirm that you can drive safely. With proper practice, both can be cleared easily.
welcome.p4: Driving lessons usually happen in two ways. One is classroom sessions, where road rules, traffic signals, and vehicle controls are taught. The second is practical driving, where you learn to drive on real roads under a trainer's supervision. This helps build confidence and correct mistakes.
welcome.p5: If you have limited time, you can learn the theory part online from home at your convenience. However, practical training needs the support of a qualified instructor.
welcome.p6: The most important thing is learning to drive safely — not just for your own safety, but also for everyone else on the road.
